name: get-wechat-history
description: Search, read, and export local WeChat history through a read-only MCP server with bounded freshness caching.

interface.longDescription: Initializes and diagnoses the local WeChat history reader, checks freshness on demand, searches fuzzy group names before reading a selected chat, returns compact message pages, exports complete chat history, and decodes requested image messages.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check history freshness once, search a vague group name when needed, then read only the minimum WeChat messages needed for my request.
